statements.markdown: **Proposition 6.126 (Changing one support bit at a doubled rank).** *Let two supports agree except that the second includes $N+1$ while the first does not. At the argument $2(N+1)$ their divisor counts differ by exactly $1$, because $N+1$ divides $2(N+1)$. More generally the difference at a positive argument $m$ is $\mathbf1_{N+1\mid m}$. The linked statements apply this identity to the finite supports in their hypotheses. No conclusion about a different coefficient sequence follows without identifying its own support change.*
